data.description:
BOARD REQUEST (DM conversation 7, msg 555, 2026-09-07): 'I'd like to see the app in action, can you make me a demo?' Filed by the CTO on the board's behalf; the demo's shape below is the CTO's decision.

WHAT EXISTS TODAY, honestly. On master, apps/invoicing is a complete v1 SERVER: accounts + sessions + route guard (AS-40), Stripe Connect onboarding (AS-41), contract templates and generation (AS-42), client creation (AS-65), the invoice lifecycle — customer mirror, draft, finalize, send (AS-43), and the webhook receiver with signature verification, idempotency and invoice state sync (AS-44). It has NO user interface on master: views/ holds only the AS-37 scaffold page. Screen 1 of 7 (sign up / sign in, AS-45) exists on the unmerged branch feat/AS-45-onboarding-ui and is one review cycle from merge. Screens 2-7 (Connect Stripe AS-70, dashboard + invoice detail AS-48, invoice create/edit AS-46, contract create/detail AS-47) are not built. There is NO Stripe test-mode account — AS-51 is still needs_human on the board's desk — so every external call in this demo goes to stripe-mock (stateless, shape-validating, emits no webhooks) on the local compose stack. Every processor/ESP/carrier signup is board-gated (CLAUDE.md, Product), and this task opens NOTHING: no account, no key, no host, no spend.

WHAT THE DEMO IS. Two deliverables, one reproducible and one viewable.

(1) apps/invoicing/demo/: a scripted, deterministic walkthrough that a human runs with two commands (docker compose up, then node demo/run.mjs from the host — plain fetch, zero new dependencies, driving the app's own HTTP API on 127.0.0.1:8348 exactly as a browser would). It seeds a named demo freelancer and client with fixed values, then walks the Rule-1 chain in order and PRINTS what it does and what it got back, annotated in plain language: sign up -> session cookie -> start Connect onboarding (stripe-mock returns a Stripe-shaped account_link URL; the demo says so and does not pretend a hosted round trip happened) -> readiness snapshot seeded to 'ready' by the same path the suite uses -> create a client -> generate a contract from a template and show the rendered document -> draft an invoice with line items in integer minor units -> finalize -> send -> deliver a SYNTHESIZED, correctly signed invoice.paid webhook to POST /webhooks/stripe -> read the invoice back as paid. The transcript must label every step as one of: 'real app behaviour', 'stripe-mock stand-in', or 'synthesized event' — the board should never have to guess which is which. Idempotent: re-running from a fresh volume gives a byte-comparable transcript modulo ids and timestamps.

(2) A captured artifact the board views without running anything: a single static HTML page holding the annotated transcript plus screenshots of screen 1 (sign-in and sign-up modes, at 375px and a desktop width, plus one validation-error state) rendered from the merged AS-45 code. Publish it the way the company already publishes viewable artifacts — the brand-artifact and wireframe-artifact skills each publish one static page to a hosted Artifact; follow that precedent (a build script under .claude/skills/, one artifact URL file, republish to the same URL). That precedent is established and board-viewed, so it is not a new external service; if the implementer finds it requires any new account or service, STOP and route to needs_human rather than opening one. Screenshots are taken from the local compose stack by whatever the implementer can run locally with no new dependency in apps/invoicing (a headless browser on the host is acceptable capture tooling; it must not enter the app's image or lockfile — LOCK_ENTRIES=70 and DIRECT_DEPENDENCIES=['ejs','express'] do not move).

WHAT IT CAN AND CANNOT SHOW, to be stated verbatim at the top of the artifact. CAN: the whole server-side core loop working end to end on this codebase, one real screen in a real browser, the contract document the app generates, the custody guard (never in the flow of funds — the demo shows the platform key never charging anyone). CANNOT: screens 2-7 (not built); a real Stripe onboarding round trip, a real hosted invoice page, a real payment, or a real webhook (no test-mode account — AS-51); email of any kind (no ESP by design). The paid state at the end of the transcript is produced by an event WE signed, which proves our receiver and state machine, not Stripe's delivery.

WHAT THIS IS NOT. It is not AS-49 (the automated end-to-end loop with a STATEFUL Stripe double). AS-49 is a TEST with a red/green verdict inside the suite; this is a NARRATED WALKTHROUGH for a human, run from the host, outside the suite, against stripe-mock only. They drive the same chain, so the demo script must be written so AS-49's planner can lift its request sequence, and it must not grow assertions, a fake, or a verdict — the moment it wants to assert, that assertion belongs in AS-49. It is also not the acceptance run (AS-50). Not in this task: any new screen; any change to routes, lib, views or tests in apps/invoicing beyond what capture needs (expected: none); a hosted deployment of the app itself (Digital Ocean is a separate, board-gated step).

DEPENDENCY. depends_on AS-45: the only screen the demo can show lives on that branch, and building the artifact against an unmerged branch would publish screenshots of code that can still change. AS-45 is a two-line rework from merge (cycle 4 authorized 2026-09-07). Nothing else gates this: no AS-51, no AS-49, no AS-70. When later screens merge, the demo is re-run and re-captured — the reproducible half is the point; the artifact is a snapshot of it.

VERIFICATION: (a) a fresh clone + docker compose up + the one host command produces the full transcript with exit 0 and every step labelled; (b) the network-off suite and the contract suite are unchanged and green (the demo adds nothing to either); (c) the artifact page opens at its URL and matches the transcript the reviewer generates independently (ids/timestamps aside); (d) the reviewer confirms by grep that the artifact's 'cannot' list is present and true — a demo that overclaims is the failure mode here.

BOARD GATES HIT: none, so long as it stays on stripe-mock, local compose, and the existing artifact precedent. Ticks: ~3 (plan, implement, review) after AS-45 merges.
data.title: D1 demo for the board: scripted local-compose walkthrough of the v1 core loop + a viewable captured artifact

data.body: BOARD RULING (DM conversation 7, msg 567, 2026-09-07 17:42Z, verbatim: 'do chat first'), answering the question put in DM msg 565: AS-90 is NOT exempt from the Chat-first scheduling rule (board directive DM msg 557; CLAUDE.md 'Scheduling priority'). It enters in_planning only when BOTH hold: (a) AS-45 has merged (the existing depends_on) and (b) the Chat set is empty — the 16 critical-priority Chat:/apps-chat tasks, AS-91 first. Honest cost so nobody is surprised later: each of those tasks is ~3 ticks (plan / implement / review) plus any rework cycles, so the demo sits on the order of 40–50 ticks behind the front of the queue, after in-flight AS-45 cycle 4 and AS-75 finish. Priority stays high (D1 priorities untouched per msg 565) and the scope in the description stands as filed; this comment is the record of the ruling, not a status change.

PULLED INTO PLANNING (cto-owen, tick watcher:79108 loop tick 2, 2026-09-12). Both gates in the 2026-09-07 ruling are now met: AS-45 merged, and the Chat-before-D1 rule was lifted by the board on 2026-09-11 (CLAUDE.md § Scheduling priority — priority means product impact; lattice next with the age tiebreak). Under that rule this is the highest-priority READY task after AS-103 (still gated on the settings hook spike): AS-49 waits on AS-69 -> AS-70 -> AS-71, AS-50 waits on the AS-51 board gate, and this one depends only on AS-45. It is also the one board request in the backlog (DM msg 555). Planning lane opens beside the AS-124 and AS-126 reviews under WIP 3.

PLANNED (cto-owen, tick watcher:79108 loop tick 2). Plan at .lattice/plans/task_01M1YB78T82XQM2P3P41G7T2J3.md. ONE CORRECTION TO MY OWN DESCRIPTION: the running web container cannot reach stripe-mock — lib/stripe/client.js line 14 makes baseUrl an option, never configuration (an env-settable base URL would send the secret key wherever the environment says; AS-38 decision), server.js builds the client against api.stripe.com, and deploy-shape pins web off the mock network. A host-driven demo against web would 503 at /connect-stripe/start (no key) and has no read-back route either. DECISION: the demo runs as a new demo compose service in the shipped image on the internal stripe-mock network, the contract service's shape — boots the same app code in-process on loopback and drives it over real HTTP; one line for the board: docker compose run --rm --build demo && docker compose down. No config row added; the tangent (INVOICING_STRIPE_BASE_URL) is parked for AS-49/50. MEASURED: stripe-mock's account fixture is NOT ready (charges_enabled false, 6 requirements due) so readiness is seeded by a synthesized signed account.updated through the real receiver; the mock's invoice amount_due is a constant 1000, so the demo invoice is exactly $10.00 (said in the transcript) or the reconciliation guard 409s. Baseline with --build: test 405/387/0/18 skipped, contract 405/405/0/0, both Built (logs in scratchpad/agent-cto-owen/AS-90/). CAPTURE: Google Chrome is on the host — headless --screenshot for the GET states, and a zero-dependency CDP driver over node's built-in WebSocket for the POST-only S1-ERROR-VALIDATION state (fallback recorded). No new install, no account, no spend, no board gate. Test pins that move, listed in the plan §0.6: deploy-shape service/COPY/BUILT counts +1 and a new demo-service case; demo/ joins dependency-policy SKIPPED_DIRS plus a guard that app source never imports from demo/. The description's 'expected: none' for test changes was wrong by those literals; lib/routes/views/public/package*.json stay byte-identical. Labels: the three from the description, printed verbatim; DB read-backs are REAL APP BEHAVIOUR with 'no screen yet (AS-48/AS-47)' said. No assertions, no verdict; the only checks are next-step preconditions and a broken chain exits 1 naming the step. Artifact: docs/demo/d1/ committed (transcript + 5 PNG + capture.json), .claude/skills/d1-demo-artifact/ per the two precedents, CAN/CANNOT block verbatim first under the title with a committed digest so build.mjs refuses a drifted copy. Predicted branch counts 406/388/0/18 and 406/406/0/0. STAFFING: implementer developer-lena (AS-43/44 are hers — the sequence, the signing, the readiness path are the hard half; screen 1 capture needs no template knowledge); reviewer qa-priya (cold on Lena's block — Ruben just did AS-124; Priya also holds the dated screen-1 ledger join). OPEN, time-boxed: Q1 data-URI images under the Artifact CSP (default: ship, fall back to GitHub raw URLs); Q2 whether the Artifact tool is callable from a headless tick — both precedents were published live (default: commit the built page, ask for one live-session publish; AC-11's URL half recorded as pending, not passed); Q3 CDP within 1 h else the file:// fallback. Branch feat/AS-90-d1-demo and worktree .worktrees/AS-90 created from 09386e2; no overlap with AS-124/AS-126.

IMPLEMENTED (developer-lena, tick watcher:79108 loop tick 3). Branch feat/AS-90-d1-demo tip 54574ea, four commits (0aee66f demo service + pins; 4990d9d cookie name / key spelling / send wording; 54574ea capture + page + staged skill). Diff vs merge-base: 18 files, +2059/-12; NOTHING under lib/, routes/, views/, public/, app.js, server.js, package*.json, or test/screens.test.js (AC-10, AC-13 by git diff --stat, empty).

WHAT: apps/invoicing/demo/run.mjs (BOOT/SEQUENCE/PRINT, no import from test/, refuses at load without ASC_STRIPE_MOCK_URL or on a stripe.com host — exit 2; a broken chain STOPs with exit 1); demo/README.md; compose demo service (contract's shape, command node demo/run.mjs); Dockerfile COPY apps/invoicing/demo; deploy-shape pins +1 each (services 5, COPIES 10, BUILT 4, env entries 6) plus a demo-service case that also re-pins web off the mock network and the COPY; dependency-policy: demo in SKIPPED_DIRS with a reason + a demo/-import guard folded into the closed-world case (cardinality asserted = SCANNED); README § Demo; docs/demo/d1/{transcript.txt, 5 PNG, capture.json, index.html}; the skill (SKILL.md, build.mjs, capture.mjs).

RECEIPTS (all -p asc-inv-as90 from the worktree, --build, torn down after): branch test 'Image asc-inv-as90-test Built' 406/388/0/18; contract 'Image asc-inv-as90-contract Built' 406/406/0/0 — exactly the plan's §5 prediction, re-taken after all mutants (final-test.log, final-contract.log in my scratchpad). Demo: three runs, each 'Image asc-inv-as90-demo Built', exit 0, 13 labelled steps / 13 headers (AC-2 greps both 13). AC-6: runs 1v2 and 2v3 normalised byte-identical; raw diff 29 of 170 lines, every one an acct_/in_ id, a UUID, an ISO timestamp, a t=/v1= digest, or the loopback port. Epilogue: 10 Stripe requests on 8 distinct paths, none of /v1/charges|payment_intents|transfers|payouts.

REDS (each mutate / assert-applied-at-site / observe / restore / git diff --exit-code clean / rebuild): AC-1 unitAmountMinor 1500 -> 'STOPPED at step 9: expected 303, got 409 (AmountMismatchError: reconcile)', exit 1. AC-8 a POST /v1/charges step -> 'STOPPED at step 0: StripeCustodyError: CUSTODY: endpoint_not_allowed on POST /v1/charges', exit 1 (before any transport call). AC-9a delete the demo COPY -> test image 406/386/2/18, red set = {deploy-shape: the parsers read the manifests…, deploy-shape: the demo service is the contract service…} — TWO, one wider than the plan's one, because the new case also pins the COPY (deliberate). AC-9b never-called import('../demo/run.mjs') in lib/health.js -> 406/387/1/18, red set = {the scan examines exactly the files…} with 'app source imports from demo/ … [lib/health.js]'. AC-2 delete step 7's label in a scratch transcript -> build.mjs 'step without label'. AC-3 one word changed in the block -> 'CAN/CANNOT block digest mismatch' (SHA-256 9c6f399b… pinned in build.mjs). Extra build reds: truncated epilogue, missing PNG, capture.json/state disagreement — all throw. AC-5: unreachable base -> exit 2, 0 files; wrong expected state -> refused, 0 files; pointing at '/' SURVIVED at first — a signed-out '/' redirects to /signin?next=%2F which IS S1-DEFAULT-SIGNIN on the same origin, so the plan's 'data-state absent' premise does not hold — capture.mjs now also refuses when the landing path differs from the requested path (plan §1.7 says a redirect is refused); re-run -> exit 1 'page landed on /signin?next=%2F, expected /', 0 files.

PLAN CORRECTIONS, all boring, all in the code: POST /clients requires next (passes next=/; Location /?clientId=<uuid>); POST /invoices requires daysUntilDue (30); account.updated answers 'ok: readiness' not 'ok: applied'; stripe-mock v0.203.0 401s sk_test_demo_placeholder (a second underscore) so the placeholder is sk_test_demoplaceholder (still spelled apart from the suite's three); ids are UUIDs not ULIDs, so the reviewer's §1.4 sed needs one more rule: s/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}/<uuid>/g; the block has 8 bullets over 16 lines (AC-3 says 12); compose v5 prints build progress on STDOUT ahead of the container's output, so transcript.txt is stdout from the title line 'D1 core-loop walkthrough (AS-90)' onward (documented in SKILL.md step 1).

FINDING WORTH THE REVIEWER'S EYE: step 10 (send) makes THREE mock calls, not one — invoiceitems, finalize, send — because lib/invoices/lifecycle.js skips steps 3–4 only when the mirror is past 'draft', and the mock never advances it. A mock artifact of the resumable pipeline, not a defect; the transcript says so in words at step 10; against real Stripe it is one call. Plan §5 predicted 8 calls; the honest number here is 10.

DEVIATIONS: (1) .claude/ is a permission-sensitive path for this sub-agent (Write and mkdir both denied), so SKILL.md/build.mjs/capture.mjs are STAGED at docs/demo/d1-demo-artifact-skill/ written exactly for .claude/skills/d1-demo-artifact/ — one 'git mv docs/demo/d1-demo-artifact-skill .claude/skills/d1-demo-artifact' by the orchestrator (both precedent skills were committed as metawork). Design unchanged. (2) Q2: the Artifact tool is not reachable from this sub-agent, so the built page is committed at docs/demo/d1/index.html (precedent content shape: title+style+markup); AC-11's URL half is PENDING one live-session run of the skill (steps 3–5). (3) Plan §4 step 5 assumed 8348 free; the main checkout's asc-invoicing-web-1 holds it and was not touched — the capture ran against a one-off branch web on 127.0.0.1:8349 (docker compose -p asc-inv-as90 run -d -p 127.0.0.1:8349:8348 --name asc-inv-as90-web web), removed after with its volume and network. (4) The CDP path worked (Q3), no fallback; capture.json records method 'cdp', Chrome/152.0.7977.83, branchCommit 4990d9d (the tip at capture time — the capture commit cannot name itself), screen1MergeCommit 95b5ee5.

VISUAL OBSERVATIONS (the plan asked): all five PNGs render the dark theme with tokens applied (13–26 kB each, far under 300 kB). S1-ERROR-VALIDATION at 375: title 'Sign in — fix the highlighted fields', a danger banner '1 field needs attention', email retained, the password field outlined in the danger colour with 'This field is required.' beneath. At 1280 the form sits in a narrow left column with the right two-thirds empty and the h1 sits tight against the first label — layout observations for the screen's owner, not defects of this task.

LEFTOVERS: /tmp/asc-demo-chrome-ephAwb (a Chrome profile from the first capture run, which hung before I added the explicit exit; removal is outside my allowed paths — rm -rf it). Scratch logs: scratchpad/agent-developer-lena/AS-90/. Not transitioning; Owen moves to review (Priya).

ARTIFACT PUBLISHED (cto-owen, from the board's live session, 2026-09-12 — the one live-session publish the plan's Q2 asked for). URL: https://claude.ai/code/artifact/ec9141f0-8627-4bf9-9020-c9f09ed3559b (version 1). Input: build.mjs re-run from the branch worktree at afac7a0 — output byte-identical to the committed docs/demo/d1/index.html (cmp), builder receipts: CAN/CANNOT 16 lines 8 bullets digest ok; 13 headers 13 labels; 5 of 5 PNGs 99258 bytes; 161.3 kB total; data: images rendered under the Artifact CSP (Q1 resolved: ship). AC-11's URL half is now met. Skill step 4's artifact-url.txt is NOT yet on the branch: the live session's harness denied every write under .claude/ — the orchestrator writes .claude/skills/d1-demo-artifact/artifact-url.txt with the URL above in the next tick that can and commits it on feat/AS-90-d1-demo. Priya: the published page is the committed index.html exactly; review the file, the URL is its projection.
